segments.text: A second-year student at Toshinoka Academy. She and Yuu have been childhood friends for a long time, but this summer they officially became lovers.

She is a girl with motherly qualities who takes care of Yuu in place of his parents, who are always away working. Cleaning, laundry, and cooking are her specialty. At first glance, she seems like the reliable Yamato Nadeshiko type, but in fact she is a gentle soul with a fluffy, airy disposition, and goes into full pampering mode when it comes to Yuu. Her friends have even given her the embarrassing nickname "Guy Spoiler (for Yuu only)." She herself doesn't care about that at all, and embraces Yuu with her usual smile.
She seems very interested in trying naughty things with Yuu. She wants to do anything that Yuu wants to do, or wants her to do, including naughty things.

A positive and brave girl, she cherishes her simple days with Yuu more than anything else. She is a heartwarming heroine whose deep affection for Yuu can be seen in every scene of daily life - her every word, and her every little smile.
Translated from the official website
兎仔華（としのか）学園に通う２年生。
祐とは長い間、幼馴染の関係だったが、この夏に晴れて正式に恋人同士となった。
共働きでいつも家に居ない祐の両親に代わって祐を甲斐甲斐しくお世話をするお母さん属性を持つ女の子。
掃除、洗濯、料理はお手のもの。しっかり者の大和撫子……と思いきや、実はぽあぽあ系の天然気質の温厚な性格で、祐に対しては甘やかしモード全開。
それは友人たちから「ダメ男製造機（祐限定）」という不名誉な異名を与えられるほど。
けれど彼女自身は、そんなことを少しも気にせず、今日も変わらぬ笑顔で祐を優しく包み込む。
恋人となった祐とのエッチな事に興味津々なご様子。
祐がしてほしい事、したい事（エッチ含む）は何でもしてあげたいと想っている。
そんな前向きで健気な彼女は、祐とのささやかな日々を何よりも大切にしている。
日常の一コマ一コマ、言葉の端々やふとした笑顔の中に、祐への深い愛情が窺える――そんな心温まるヒロインです。

A second-year student at Toshinoka Academy.

Yui is a classmate of Yuu and Nozomi. They met in their first year at the Academy and became good friends. She is the mood maker of the group. Always bringing energy to the group, she even manages to play both the boke and tsukkomi at the same time.
She is cheerful and energetic. She is noisy. But somehow, you can't hate her. Before you know it, she's at the center of some commotion or another.

Yui is secretly proud of the fact that her breasts have recently grown a little. However, when she sees that Nozomi's breasts have grown more rapidly than hers after getting a boyfriend, she makes an absurd (but she's serious) complaint, saying, "That is so typical of girls who have boyfriends..."

Yui seems to be very curious about the relationship between Yuu and Nozomi, who are now lovers. When she found an insect bite on Yuu's neck, she mistook it for a love bite and made a fuss. She's friendly with Yuu but is often harsh on him because Nozomi, whom she loves, always pays attention to him... But that might just be the flip side of a secret feeling deep in her heart.
She's always lively and full of energy, but at certain moments, she shows her delicate, girly side. Will the day ever come when she becomes aware of her own feelings?
Translated from the official website
兎仔華（としのか）学園の２年生。
祐と希美のクラスメイトで二人とは１年の時に学園で知り合って仲良くなった。
祐たちメンバーのムードメーカーであり、ボケとツッコミを一人でこなすお騒がせガール。
明るく元気！ 騒がしくてうるさい！ でも憎めない！ 気づけば何かしらの騒ぎの中心にいたりする。
最近、ちょっとだけ胸が育ってきたのが密かな誇りだった。
だが、恋人ができたことで自分以上に急成長（物理）を遂げる希美を見て、「これだから彼氏持ちは……」と、くだらない（でも本人は真剣）抗議をしたりする。
恋人同士となった祐と希美の関係！？に興味津々なご様子。
祐の首元に虫刺されを見つけた際にキスマークと勘違いして騒いだこともあった。
大好きな希美がなにかにつけて祐に構うため、祐とは気安い関係もあって彼に辛辣に当たることもしばしば。
――でもそれは、ほんの少しだけ彼女の胸の奥にある、秘めた気持ちの裏返しかもしれない。
いつも賑やかで元気いっぱい。だけど、ふとした瞬間に見せる繊細で乙女な一面。
彼女が自身の想いに気づく日は、果たして来るのだろうか――？

A second-year student at Toshinoka Academy.

She is a classmate of Yuu and Nozomi. Like Yui, she became friends with them after meeting them in their first year. Her calm personality and refined looks make her the big sister character of the group. While she is cool and intelligent, she also has a somewhat naive side that is not very versed with wordly affairs. This gap is one of her charms.
Usually calm and collected, and possessing of a strong common sense, she often gives accurate tsukkomi to the lively commotion that Nozomi, Yui, and Yuu cause.

Like Yui, she seems to be very curious about the relationship between Yuu and Nozomi, who have become lovers. She and Yui fretted about Yuu and Nozomi's will-they-won't-they relationship for a long time.
Although she usually hides it, she is secretly worried that she has the smallest breasts of the three.

And there is one more thing she cannot tell anyone - she has always had feelings for Yuu that are more than just friendship, but she has put a lid on those feelings because she doesn't want to ruin their current relationship. But one day, a sudden event causes that lid to begin to waver. Having continued to turn a blind eye to her own feelings, the day may be approaching when she finally has to face them.
Translated from the official website
兎仔華（としのか）学園の２年生。
祐と希美のクラスメイトで
ゆいと同じく二人とは１年のときに出会って以来、自然と仲良くなった。
落ち着いた性格と整った容姿から希美たちの姉貴分ポジションにいる。
クールで理知的な一方、やや世間に疎い天然な一面もあり、そのギャップが彼女の魅力となっている。
基本的には冷静沈着で常識人のため、希美、ゆい、祐の3人が繰り広げる賑やかな騒動に的確なツッコミを入れることが多い。
ゆいと同じで恋人同士となった祐と希美の関係！？に興味津々なご様子。
二人が中々恋人同士にならないことゆいと一緒にヤキモキしていた。
普段はそんな姿を見せないが、３人の中では胸が一番小さいことをひそかに気にしている。
そしてもうひとつ、誰にも言えない想い――
祐に対して、ずっと友達以上の感情を抱いてきたが、今の関係を壊したくないとその気持ちに蓋をしていた。
だがある日、その蓋がふとした出来事で揺らぎ始める。
自分の気持ちから目をそらし続けていた彼女が自身の想いに向き合う日も近いかもしれない。

Yuu's grandfather.
At first glance he appears like a stubborn old man, but in reality he is a very loving grandfather who cares deeply for his grandson. He runs a small guesthouse in the countryside where Yuu was born.
Together with his now late wife, he looked after Yuu when he was a child in place of his parents, who were often absent. Even after Yuu began living in the city, he continues to worry about him.

He invites Yuu and his friends to the guesthouse during the summer holidays. He is happy to see his grandson looking healthy after not seeing him in a long time, but is surprised to find out that he has brought a girlfriend.
He wishes his grandson happiness in the future, and, although it is a little premature, he is hopeful that he will have a great-grandson.
Translated from the official website
Yuu is a second-year student at Toshinoka Academy, the same school that Nozomi and the others go to.

Yuu and Nozomi have been childhood friends ever since he left the countryside where he was born and raised and moved to the city. They had been attracted to each other for a long time, but this summer they officially became a couple.

He is an honor student, with top grades and excellence in both study and sports. Although he can be a little rough around the edges, he is well-regarded by girls for his toned body and relatively good looks. However, when it comes to the all-important aspect of romance, he is a blockhead.

Due to family circumstances, he should be able to do all the household chores himself, but after Nozomi started to take care of him, he found himself leaving all the housework to her before he knew it.
Since becoming a couple, the everyday life he spends with Nozomi has felt even more dazzling...
Translated from the official website
